verdict.rationale: Bun ships strong default protection against malicious lifecycle scripts: it does not execute postinstall/lifecycle scripts by default, and platform-engineers can allowlist trusted packages via `trustedDependencies` (bun-docs-19, bun-docs-4). There is also a supply-chain audit command that checks the npm advisory database (bun-docs-6, bun-docs-7). However, no evidence exists of a 'minimum release age' enforcement feature, which is explicitly part of the user story. Missing for 10: minimum-release-age enforcement/config, independent/hands-on confirmation of the lifecycle-script blocking behavior in practice.
